tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon observations and authorized mechanism notes support endogenous dual-horizon adaptation, but the target horizon is far outside the measured range. The slow-horizon discriminating probe is needed to identify the reversal and calibrate the long-horizon forecast.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential reversal from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations have H <= 0.48, so they do not identify slow-horizon behavior or forecast reliably to H=21.7.
More short-horizon samples would not resolve the slow-timescale ambiguity as directly.
Nuisance auxiliary data are irrelevant to the stated mechanisms.
